description: This file defines a class 'FileEventSubscriber' that implements event handling for sanitizing uploaded filenames in Drupal. It listens for file upload events and processes filenames to ensure they conform to sanitization rules such as transliteration, replacing whitespace, deduplication of separators, and converting to lowercase.

classes.name: FileEventSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to file upload events to sanitize filenames according to configured rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects configuration, transliteration, and language management services.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the file upload sanitize event to the handler method 'sanitizeFilename'.

methods.name: sanitizeFilename
methods.description: Handles the filename sanitization process, applying transliteration, whitespace replacement, separator deduplication, and case conversion based on configuration settings.
